'''CC-1226''' was a [[clone trooper]] who served in the [[Imperial Military]]. Following the [[mission to Desix]], [[Crosshair]] was ordered by [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] to report to CC-1226 for his next assignment, after [[Clone Commander]] [[Cody|CC-2224]] went [[Desertion|AWOL]].<ref name="Solitary" />
